result.detail:
Deviations recorded for the tech lead (design.rtl.design.tech_lead).
(1) Formal proof at WIDTH 1: [artifact:prj-fed4b510c5.interface-spec.a1] section 6 requires a formal proof at WIDTH 8 and 1, and the microarchitecture plans a second job, skid_buffer_w1.sby. formal.run accepts exactly one formal_spec file, so only WIDTH 8 is submitted for proof. WIDTH 1 is exercised in simulation only, by a second DUT instance in the testbench. This follows the design/pipeline_design guidance to check other parameter points in simulation.
(2) Lint at WIDTH 1: the platform's lint.run is expected to cover the default WIDTH 8 only. Lint at WIDTH 1 is not separately requested.
(3) Data reset: the data registers are deliberately not reset, as the approved microarchitecture state table specifies.
Independent review is still required after the platform checks.
